notes: Fix: Progress, Stats and Review now count the recitation still running, as if you had stopped it.
Fix: a recitation cut short by a crash, or by closing the app from the recent apps, is saved as if you had stopped it.
New: Review cards name their ayat (for example Al-Baqarah 12-13), and the page says what today's mistakes became.
Change: a card's buttons sit just above the recite bar, in one row; Suspend, Bury and the list are under the three-dot button.
Change: during a card, the stop button only turns the microphone off; nothing is graded until you press Next.
New: with the microphone off, the next-word button shows each word as read in your mind; mark a mistake by hand.
Fix: a card shows only its grey lines, starts on a clean page, and Next card moves to another place.
Fix: the Back button during a card returns to the Review page instead of leaving the app.
Change: starting a card stops a running recitation by itself and saves it.
New: Settings > Phone > Keep the screen on for at least 5 min (on by default).
